A two dimensional vector unit whose elements are stored as integers. ==Constructors== {| class="wikitable" ! Constructor !! Description |- | cVector2l(int, int) || Creates a cVector2l with the given element data. |} ==Fields== {| class="wikitable" ! Field Name !! Type !! Parameters !! Description |- | int || GetElement || uint64 alIdx || Gets the value at the given index. (Indices 0 and 1 are equal to x and y, respectively.) |- | void || SetElement || uint64 alIdx,
int || Sets the value at the given index to the given value. (Indices 0 and 1 are equal to x and y, respectively.) |- | int || SqrLength || || Returns the length-squared of the vector. |} {{ReferencesSection}} {{HPL3SOMAScriptingCategories}} __FORCETOC__
